csv_scope_of_work: The City of Milton-Freewater, Oregon invites Statements of Qualifications for professional engineering services associated with a Substation Upgrade Project. The project may include design and engineering support for power transformer replacement, 69 kV switching improvements, bus modifications, voltage regulator upgrades, control building improvements, and related electric system resiliency infrastructure.

title: Engineering for Milton Substation Upgrade
short_description: Engineering services for upgrading an electrical substation and related resiliency infrastructure.
project_scope: Substation upgrade project including possible power transformer replacement, 69 kV switching improvements, bus modifications, voltage regulator upgrades, control building improvements, and related electric system resiliency infrastructure.
services: Professional engineering services; requested disciplines include architecture services, programming, civil engineering, and electrical engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Project is an electrical substation upgrade, not a bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special lightweight structure.
- Main focus is utility/electrical infrastructure rather than structural engineering of complex load-bearing systems.
- Includes some civil engineering and control building improvements, but no significant structural scope is described.
- Limited fit with sbp's core profile in bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, and architecturally demanding buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source.
